name: late-join-collapse
description: T17. Clients 0 and 1 keep cutting: client 0 detaches the bridge beam then excavates the floor along +X, client 1 excavates a separate brick. Client 2 is a --late-join replica that connects ~900 ms in, pulls a dependency-complete baseline over a real QUIC bulk transfer, drains the server's catch-up queue, and lands one cut of its own. The server and all three clients must converge to one canonical topology hash; the server must report one completed late join.
